images.after: Why Google Drive, Dropbox and iCloud aren't backups
images.title: Sync service vs backup service
images.alt: Comparison of a sync service, which copies deletions and overwrites to every device, and a backup service, which keeps older file versions.
images.caption: Keep using sync for convenience, but don't count it as one of your three copies.

columns.label: Sync service
points: A deleted folder is deleted everywhere
Overwrites and scrambled files sync too
Short safety net for deleted files

columns.label: Backup service
points: Copies your files to its servers
Keeps older versions of each file
Lets you go back to last week's version

images.after: Step 3: Back up the things that aren't on your computer
images.title: Four things your computer backup misses
images.alt: Four cards: website database and files, email list export, password manager kit and 2FA codes, and phone photos and video.
images.caption: None of these is caught by the cloud backup or the external drive, so each needs its own export.

items.title: Your website
items.text: On WordPress, back up the database and the files, and download a copy.

items.title: Your email list
items.text: Export subscribers to a CSV monthly into a folder your backups cover.

items.title: Recovery kit and 2FA codes
items.text: Print them, and don't keep them only on the computer they help you unlock.

items.title: Phone photos and video
items.text: Copy originals to your computer so both backups pick them up.

images.after: Test a restore before you need one
images.title: How to test a restore
images.alt: Five steps to test backups: pick a file from each backup, restore to a new folder, open it, check the website backup, and write down the steps.
images.caption: Until you've restored something, you don't know whether your backups work.

items.title: Pick two files
items.text: One from the cloud backup and one from the external drive.

items.title: Restore to a different folder
items.text: Restore each file to a different folder from the original.

items.title: Open them
items.text: Open each restored file to confirm it works.

items.title: Check the website
items.text: Restore to a staging copy, or at least check the database export is recent and not empty.

items.title: Write it down
items.text: Note the steps you took and keep the note with your recovery codes.
